name: goldbar
description: A gold band above the Claude Code prompt showing your 5-hour, weekly and per-model usage limits as pills that pulse while Claude works, plus a spinner for background tasks. Colors, labels and pill counts are configurable.

showBackground.title: Show background tasks
showBackground.description: Spinner and count of running background tasks, at the left.

showModel.title: Show model bar
showModel.description: One model's own weekly limit (see Model name).

modelName.title: Model name
modelName.description: Which model's weekly limit the third bar shows, as /usage names it (Fable, Opus, Sonnet).

weeklyPills.title: Weekly pills
weeklyPills.description: Pills in the weekly bar (1 to 14).

modelPills.title: Model pills
modelPills.description: Pills in the model bar (1 to 14).

goldStart.title: First pill color
goldStart.description: Hex color of the first pill; the pills shade toward Last pill color.

goldEnd.title: Last pill color
goldEnd.description: Hex color of the last pill.

labelColor.title: Label color
labelColor.description: Hex color of the bar labels.

valueColor.title: Number color
valueColor.description: Hex color of the percentages, reset time and task count.

dividerColor.title: Divider color
dividerColor.description: Hex color of the lines between bars.

trackColor.title: Empty pill color
trackColor.description: Hex color of the unfilled pills (drawn faint).

showResetTime.title: Show reset time
showResetTime.description: The ↻ countdown to the weekly reset.

pulse.title: Pulse while working
pulse.description: Pills swell left to right while Claude is working.

pulseSeconds.title: Pulse speed
pulseSeconds.description: Seconds for one swell to cross the bar.

modelRefreshMinutes.title: Model refresh (minutes)
modelRefreshMinutes.description: How often to fetch the model bar's figure, at most.
